items.headline: Europe's drug regulator recommends approval of the first pill targeting the main driver of pancreatic cancer
items.summary: The European Medicines Agency recommended approving daraxonrasib, sold as Rasonque, for metastatic pancreatic cancer that has worsened after earlier treatment. In a 500-patient phase three trial, people taking the pill lived a median of 12.4 months, compared with 6.7 months on chemotherapy.
items.why_it_matters: Survival nearly doubled in one of the deadliest cancers, which has had few effective treatments once it spreads.
